item.title: ChimeraLM: Structural Variant Detection in WGA Long-Read Sequencing
item.description: ChimeraLM is a language model for accurate structural variant detection in whole-genome amplified (WGA) long-read sequencing data. It is described in the paper A Language Model Enables Accurate Structural Variant Detection in Whole-Genome Amplified Long-Read Sequencing.

item.title: DeepChopper: Removing Chimeras in Nanopore Direct RNA Sequencing
item.description: DeepChopper is a genomic language model built on HyenaDNA that identifies and removes adapter-bridged chimera artifacts in nanopore direct RNA sequencing data. It is described in the paper Genomic Language Model Mitigates Chimera Artifacts in Nanopore Direct RNA Sequencing.

BINARY: A Bioinformatics Algorithm Library in Modern C++
item.description: BINARY is a collection of algorithms and data structures built for modern C++ bioinformatics applications. You can use it directly in your own projects or as a component of a larger system. Every data structure and algorithm is implemented in modern C++ with an emphasis on efficiency.

item.title: BOSS: A Bioinformatics Toolbox in Modern C++
item.description: BOSS is a bioinformatics toolbox written in modern C++. Each tool is designed to be easy to use and fast, and the whole codebase is tested exhaustively. BOSS is free software distributed under the GNU General Public License v3.
